script.source: Covering Fire and Immobilizing Shot both store EnableRootWithChance and the same Root activation strings. Covering Fire stores 15 percent proc chance, eight seconds and fifty percent damage-break value. The retained 254 release path pairs the state and linked removal with a single Rooted end message.
script.runtime: The landed 176 modifier attaches the same chance/first-hit protection and publishes the source-specific caster and target Root messages with the break value. Natural expiry and qualifying incoming damage both release the current Rooted generation and restore movement.
script.test: RootWithBreakChancePublishesAuthoredActivationAndOneStateEnd tests both natural and damage-induced removal of 176 and retained 254. PR949 stock renders the caster Root line, the helper verifies the recipient text and paired 274/275 removal, and the same player transitions from corrected movement and −1 scale to its ordinary movement with a single state-end. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/949#issuecomment-7095667026

source-parity.source: Current Covering Fire stores fixed Ballistic damage 17 and the Root proc. The old SMG prone handler is in old_sm_smg.py, outside the shipped abilities.py importer. The identical current Root string fields and the retained 254 sibling determine the complete presentation.
source-parity.runtime: The playable SMG action uses the current authored damage and Root effects. AbilityMessages.RootWithBreakChance uses the shared activation layout and TimedEffects preserves the ordinary Rooted release lifecycle.
source-parity.test: PR941 records the natural Root proc on an actual at-rest 176 and the interlock 21083 result. PR949 reproduces localization and (with a fixed modifier proc after the landed hit) observes paired expiry and movement recovery. Existing chance boundary tests qualify the natural draw. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/941#issuecomment-7094930174 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/949#issuecomment-7095667026

behavior-tests.source: Shipped 176 requires a single SMG style, a selected hostile, four seconds, 25 IS and 8/5 s reuse. The action can land directly or in an admitted interlock and gives a chance-driven timed Root.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler checks the selected target and equipped weapon through release, retains the original combat route, and invokes typed damage, gameplay Root state and paired movement restoration on the qualified target.
behavior-tests.test: PR941 stock demonstrates at-rest 18, natural Root admission/release, 21083 interlock 18 and a spent weapon-swap fizzle without queue or hit. PR949 stock adds the source-backed presentation and recipient movement witness. The focused tests cover stale target/weapon, Root break threshold, expiry and both conditional records. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/941#issuecomment-7094930174 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/949#issuecomment-7095667026
